During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Wyrd]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]] [[Coven/Legends|coven]] established a '''enclave''' inside a [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] on the dormant [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] [[Cloud Mountain]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The cavern was founded at the site of the [[Hand artifact]] an ancient statue and [[Dark side artifact/Legends|dark side relic]] that could be used to enhance the Force strength of its user by drawing on the life force of the victim.<ref name="From The Trees" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the Living Force adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''[[From the Trees]]'' is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the Wyrd kidnapped the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] [[Chywarra]] and took him to their enclave.<ref name="From The Trees" />
